events.title: Steam Deck Support Now Available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection now supports Steam Deck!Take your chest-smashing adventures on the go, collect loot, and build your monster card collection wherever you play.Give it a try on your Steam Deck and let us know how it works for you!

events.title: Better Performance
events.summary: Hello everyone,The latest update is now live!This update brings performance improvements, enhanced visual effects, and clearer in-game hints to make your gameplay experience smoother, more polished, and easier to follow.Thank you for playing! We’ll continue working to improve the game and make your adventure even better.

events.title: New Card Pack Design
events.summary: Hello everyone,With the game's new subtitle, "Cardimonsta Collection," we've also given the card packs a fresh new look.The new design is more detailed and visually rich than the previous version, making the card packs feel more distinctive and exciting.We've also updated the artwork for several cards and made some improvements to the in-game descriptions.We hope you enjoy the new designs and changes!

events.title: New Subtitle
events.summary: Hello everyone,To make the game more unique and help support its future growth, the game’s subtitle will be changed from “Monster Card Collection” to “Cardimonsta Collection.”Cardimonsta is the IP name of the card packs featured in the game.I hope everyone will continue to support the game in the future!

events.title: New version is now available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,The latest update improves the early-game guidance and overall progression flow, while adding support for more languages.We’ve also added a Reset Button, allowing players who want to experience the game again from the beginning to restart their progress and replay the game.

events.title: Demo is now available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,We're excited to announce that the demo for Chest Looter: Monster Card Collection is now officially available on Steam! We hope you enjoy it!Your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports will play a huge role in shaping the game's future and making it even better.

events.title: Playtest is now available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,We're excited to announce that Chest Looter: Monster Card Collection is now available for playtesting on itch.io!https://visionparty.itch.io/chestlootermonstercardcollectionOpen chests, collect unique cards, and grow stronger with endless upgrades. Unlock more powerful card packs, discover rare and unique cards, and continuously expand your collection.This playtest features the core gameplay loop, and we'd love to hear what you think.
